additionalSourceCorrectionsVerified: Strict typed critical controller/native contracts and human-readable canonical terms/fee receipt UI.
Exact canonical prepared request serialization before journal transitions.

Native/monotonic acceptance clock refreshed before offer/accept and around both signatures.
Known wallet invalidation retires private context, cached G18 guidance and pending UI scope.

axes.correctness: Exact reviewed bytes and domain hash flow through real exchange/native bundle/escrow; actual T34 backup revision, durable G12 one-send journal, native unknown recovery and terminal receipts verified. All confirmed races repaired and independently rechecked.
axes.readability: Critical controller is strict TypeScript with explicit native/service/snapshot contracts; human-readable terms/receipts are primary and diagnostic JSON secondary. Dense orchestration is bounded to one optional private composition.
axes.architecture: Uses existing same-Worker endpoint, identity, relay crypto/exchange, G08/G12/G18 and canonical native ABI. Constructor-only trusted ports cannot be supplied by runtime status payloads; default App/facades/trust pins remain excluded.
axes.security: No raw key/session leaves Worker; known lease/wallet/lock revocation fences requests and clears owned resources. Imported statuses, missing peer-carrier capability, wrong genesis/runtime and counterfeit canonical requests fail closed. On-chain actions remain original seller/buyer bound.
axes.performance: Unknown scan <=65 blocks inclusive and <=128 transactions/block; request timeout, bounded file imports and serialized physical native admission. Local proof makes no whole-WebSocket/native-runtime memory allocation guarantee.
